snippet.title: Scary Teacher 3D | Now Available on Steam | Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Get ready to face Miss T like never before! Scary Teacher 3D, the hit game loved by millions, is now on Steam! Dive into the thrilling world of pranks, puzzles, and hilarity as you outsmart the scariest teacher in town.

Whether you're solving mind-bending puzzles, escaping her traps, or pulling off the ultimate pranks, Scary Teacher 3D brings the fun and excitement of the mobile experience to your PC with enhanced graphics and gameplay.

Can you outwit Miss T and teach her a lesson she’ll never forget?

🎮 Add Scary Teacher 3D to your Steam wishlist today!

👉  https://store.steampowered.com/app/971470/Scary_Teacher_3D/?beta=0
